package customdefault_test

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	svc "example.com/customdefault/gen/customdefault"
	client "example.com/customdefault/gen/http/customdefault/client"
	server "example.com/customdefault/gen/http/customdefault/server"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestAbsentDefaultConversion(t *testing.T) {
	calls := 0
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	endpoints := &svc.Endpoints{
		Good: func(_ context.Context, payload any) (any, error) {
			calls++
			value := payload.(*svc.GoodPayload)
			require.Equal(t, "token:default", value.Token.String())
			return &svc.GoodResult{Token: value.Token}, nil
		},
		Bad: func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
			calls++
			return nil, nil
		},
	}
	server.Mount(mux, server.New(endpoints, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil, nil, nil))
	for _, name := range []string{"good", "bad"} {
		recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
		request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/"+name, strings.NewReader("{}"))
		request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		mux.ServeHTTP(recorder, request)
		if name == "good" {
			require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, recorder.Code, recorder.Body.String())
		} else {
			require.Equal(t, http.StatusInternalServerError, recorder.Code, recorder.Body.String())
		}
	}
	require.Equal(t, 1, calls, "failed defaults must not reach the service")
	good, err := client.BuildGoodPayload("{}")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "token:default", good.Token.String())
	bad, err := client.BuildBadPayload("{}")
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "invalid token prefix")
	require.Nil(t, bad)
	for _, name := range []string{"good", "bad"} {
		response := &http.Response{StatusCode: http.StatusOK, Header: make(http.Header), Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader("{}"))}
		response.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		decode := client.DecodeGoodResponse(loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
		if name == "bad" {
			decode = client.DecodeBadResponse(loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
		}
		value, err := decode(response)
		if name == "good" {
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, "token:default", value.(*svc.GoodResult).Token.String())
		} else {
			require.ErrorContains(t, err, "invalid token prefix")
			require.Nil(t, value)
		}
	}
}
